_comment: The one definition of the baseline kanban Project board every repo runs. skills/backlog/scripts/check_kanban_baseline.py compares a live board's field list with this file. Lane and option names are compared without regard to case. Area options come from each repo's own backlog config, so this file names no Area option.
rule: The board has no pull-request lane and no status that a pull request sets. A lane is an option of the Status field, and its name never refers to a pull request, a review of one or a merge.
